name: sdd
description: A spec-driven workflow with lightweight milestone memory: /milestone clarifies the intended outcome, tracks work not yet represented by an epic, and optionally syncs progress read-only from Beads; /specify authors stories/epics, /refine revises them, /board renders the backlog, /solve implements one in an isolated worktree, /validate merges after human review, and /orchestrate automates a whole epic behind one final PR. Requires the bd CLI for the story workflow and milestone sync.

interface.shortDescription: Track a milestone, then author, solve, validate, and orchestrate stories.
interface.longDescription: Clarify and keep the current milestone in .milestone.md, including work not yet represented in Beads, optionally sync epic progress read-only, then manage the engineering workflow from story authoring through isolated implementation, human-reviewed merge, and whole-epic orchestration behind a single final PR.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show the SDD board and help me choose the next appropriate workflow action.
